description: This Python source file defines an AWS-based conversational bot that handles speech input/output via different transports, registers a weather-fetching function, configures a language model (AWS Nova Sonic), and manages a dialogue pipeline with event handlers for client connection and disconnection.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema class for defining functions that can be called by the language model.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining tools (functions) available to the language model.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame for running LLM in the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the main data processing pipeline consisting of multiple stages.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Executes and manages the lifecycle of a pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Defines a pipeline task with configuration parameters.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Stores context messages and tools for the language model conversation.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Manages context and response aggregation in the pipeline.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Arguments for configuring the pipeline runner.

classes.name: create_transport
classes.description: Utility to create transport for communication based on runner arguments.

classes.name: AWSNovaSonicLLMService
classes.description: AWS service interface for the Nova Sonic LLM.

classes.name: FunctionCallParams
classes.description: Represents parameters for a function call.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Simulates fetching weather data asynchronously based on input parameters.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and runs the main conversational bot pipeline with event handlers.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point for starting the bot, sets up transport and runs the pipeline.
